result.summary: Consolidates Bitcoin Core network privacy guidance into a new document, doc/privacy.md, and documents the private transaction broadcast feature. It moves duplicated multi-network unlinkability warnings and onion service isolation advice from doc/tor.md and doc/i2p.md into the new file. It also documents the -privatebroadcast configuration flag, its prerequisites, scope limitations, and associated RPCs.
result.problem: Privacy advice for node operators was duplicated and split across doc/tor.md and doc/i2p.md. Additionally, users had no documentation explaining how to use the -privatebroadcast feature introduced in PR 29415, what its prerequisites and limitations are (such as only covering sendrawtransaction and not wallet RPCs), or how to use getprivatebroadcastinfo and abortprivatebroadcast.
evidence: Suggested during review of PR #29415 by reviewer ismaelsadeeq to consolidate privacy documentation (PR description).

Removes verbatim duplicated text between doc/tor.md and doc/i2p.md warning node operators against exposing nodes across multiple networks if identity unlinkability is required (diff, commit 886189e83d).
result.scope_notes: Pure documentation change across four markdown files.
result.card: Creates doc/privacy.md as a single source of documentation for Bitcoin Core privacy recommendations and private transaction broadcasting. It moves duplicated multi-network unlinkability guidance out of doc/tor.md and doc/i2p.md into the new document. It also documents the -privatebroadcast option, explaining prerequisites, scope limitations to sendrawtransaction, and related RPCs. The change was suggested by reviewers during the merge of the private broadcast feature.
